flashcard_questions.q: What does the Arabic word jihad mean?
What is greater jihad in Islamic teaching?
flashcard_questions.a: The inner spiritual struggle to live as a good Muslim and resist temptation.

flashcard_questions.q: What is lesser jihad in Islamic teaching?
flashcard_questions.a: The physical or military struggle to defend Islam, permitted only as a last resort.

flashcard_questions.q: Why is greater jihad considered more important than lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: It is a lifelong, continuous struggle that every Muslim faces daily.

flashcard_questions.q: How do scholars grade the hadith about greater and lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: As weak — it does not appear in the six authoritative collections.

flashcard_questions.q: Which Qur’an verse forbids overstepping the limits when fighting?
Which Qur’an verse says Muslims must incline to peace if the enemy does?
What must be exhausted before lesser jihad can be declared?
flashcard_questions.a: Every peaceful means of resolving the conflict must be tried first.

flashcard_questions.q: Who alone may declare lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: A recognised religious authority, never an individual or a self-appointed group.

flashcard_questions.q: What does proportionality require in lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: Civilians must not be targeted and no excess is permitted.

flashcard_questions.q: How does some Shi’a teaching restrict the declaring of lesser jihad?
flashcard_questions.a: Only a divinely appointed Imam may declare it, so it cannot happen during the occultation.

flashcard_questions.q: What is occultation in Shi’a belief?
flashcard_questions.a: The hiding of the twelfth Imam, who will return at the end of time.

flashcard_questions.q: Which branch of Islam lists jihad among the Ten Obligatory Acts?
What does the festival Id-ul-Adha commemorate?
flashcard_questions.a: Ibrahim’s willingness to sacrifice his son in obedience to God’s command.

flashcard_questions.q: What is Zakat-ul-Fitr, paid before the Eid prayer?
flashcard_questions.a: A small donation so that even the poorest can join the celebration.

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (jihad, greater jihad, lesser jihad, occultation), 2 belief→source (Qur’an 2:190, Qur’an 8:61), 4 conditions for lesser jihad as separate single-fact cards, 2 denomination→position (Shi’a restriction, Ten Obligatory Acts), 3 festival cards (Id-ul-Adha, Zakat-ul-Fitr, Sunni Ashura). Noted the hadith’s weak grading as the content states it.
